in_marathi.name: Jitisha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jitisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word ‘jit’ meaning victory or triumph. In Hindu mythology, Jitisha is considered the goddess of victory, success, and wisdom. She is also known as the presiding deity of the Jyotish (astrology) field.
